_comment: The client programs enrolled with this hub, keyed by a uuid4 hex the panel assigns when a link is minted. The entry below is named with a leading underscore so it documents the shape without being read as a client. Written by the panel, never by hand: token_sha256 is the hash of the secret the program authenticates its channel with, the raw token exists only on that machine; hostname, platform and version are what the program last reported; machine_id is the id that computer generated once, so a program joining again on a new link lands on this row; ai_key_id names the gateway client key minted for it, revoked while it is disabled; permission is the kinds this client may use, or null to follow default_permission, which names the kinds every client without a permission of its own may use (all of them when the file names none). A permission's devices, written only when it names a list, narrows a kind to the entries the listed devices provide, by device id; a kind with no list allows every device, overlay takes none, and deleting a device takes its id out of every list.
